profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. describes its platform and apps as ways to earn more, eat, commute, get a ride, simplify business travel, and more. The company says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing autonomous vehicles as a key part of the future. It states that it partners with industry leaders and uses a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, trading under the ticker UBER. Its SEC CIK number is 0001543151. It also appears under the aliases "Uber Technologies, Inc" and "UBER TECHNOLOGIES INC."

No cases are listed for the company. California accounts for 281 law exposure entries.
